Commentary.Commentary: It looks like a simple road for India but they will have to be wary of any surprises Zimbabwe can throw their way. Stay tuned for the run chase.

This innings undoubtedly belonged to the Indian bowlers as Barinder Sran destroyed the batsmen with 4 vital wickets, giving away just 10 runs while doing it. Bumrah played a key role as well, applying pressure and getting the important wicket of Moor and finished with three scalps. The others were not bad either and kept the run-rate under control.

That wraps up the innings for the hosts. They fell well short of their projected score of 150-170 as the batsmen folded under the Indian bowling attack. Chibhabha got off to a promising start but was soon dismissed by Sran. Masakadza's wicket heralded the fall of the upper middle order with three wickets falling in the same over. Waller and Moor strung a partnership of note, scoring 29 runs in 37 balls and bringing some measure of stability.
Another play and a miss to end the over and innings. Muzarabani comes down the track and slashes hard, only to miss again. The hosts do not reach three figures. ZIMBABWE FINISH ON 99/9!
Outside off, 130.2 kph, on a length, a slash and a miss.
A short ball around off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single. At least, the target will be 100.
SIX! That is not a bad shot! On a length outside off, 133.3 kph, Tiripano smashes this over mid off who is inside the circle and the ball hits the ropes on the full!
WIDE. Slips this down the leg side, a flick shot missed.
TAURAI MUZARABANI is the last man in.

OUT! Gone next ball. The missed run out does not count for much. A length ball around off, Cremer looks to go over the top but is nowhere near the pitch of the ball and miscues it high in the air. Ambati Rayudu at cover initially goes back but then covers ground and takes it easily.

RUN OUT CHANCE MISSED! On middle, Tiripano flicks it straight to short mid-wicket. Cremer does not take a start at all while Tiripano comes halfway running. In the end, Cremer is forced into the run and gives up. The fielder misses his shy at the striker's end though.
DHAWAL KULKARNI to bowl the final over. Can the hosts at least get to 100?
A length ball outside off, Cremer charges down the track and swings hard. Gets a top edge which does not carry to third man. A couple taken.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Landed outside off, defended back to the bowler.
On a good length outside off, angling in, Tiripano looks to steer it to third man but is beaten.
Outside off, pushed through point for a single.
Full and outside off, 131.6 kph, pushed straight to cover.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
An LBW appeal, turned down. This one comes in sharply and stays low and hits Cremer on the pads. Sran appeals but the umpire does not budge. A run taken, leg bye signalled.
Changes the angle now, comes around the wicket.
Short and outside off, slapped through cover for a single.
Pitched on middle, angling away, pushed back towards short mid-wicket. He wants a single but is sent back.
BARINDER SRAN to bowl his final over. He is on a hat-trick.
Landed outside off, steered behind point for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
DONALD TIRIPANO walks in at number 10, replacing Madziva.

OUT! The off stump is out of the ground now! Stumps are everywhere. Madziva jumps down the track and aims to steer this through third man but the ball cuts in, beats the bat and sends the off stump cartwheeling. Third wicket for Bumrah.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
NEVILLE MADZIVA walks in at number 9, replacing Chigumbura.
OUT! Full and straight outside off, Chigumbura looks to block it but the ball seams inwards and sends the middle stump cartwheeling. Zimbabwe's last hope departs.
Full on middle, swept through square leg for a single.
A quick arm ball, on middle, following the batsman down the leg side, 99.2 kph, Chigumbura is cramped for room and mistimes it to cover.
Flighted outside off, EC comes down the track and pushes it to cover.
Quicker one on leg stump, Elton misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
FOUR! That is way too short, pulled behind square leg for a boundary.
Full on middle and off, defended towards short mid-wicket.
Length ball on middle, blocked with a straight bat back to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, defended to the off side for a single.
GRAEME CREMER walks in at number 8, replacing Moor.
OUT! Full outside off, Moor swings his bat and makes contact with the upper half of the bat. The ball is lofted behind point and Axar Patel is waiting to comfortably pocket the catch.
Short outside off, Moor drives it to mid on for a single.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Landed outside off, defended back to the bowler.
JASPRIT BUMRAH is back on.
A short ball outside off, very slow in pace, Chigumbura goes for the pull but misses.
FREE HIT COMING UP...
NO BALL! Chahal oversteps and bowls it on leg, Chigumbura works it towards short fine leg. Moor wants the strike but Chigumbura wants to make use of the free hit and sends Moor back.
On middle and leg, the wrong 'un, Elton comes down the track but is beaten in the flight and is hit on the pads.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Chigumbura misses his sweep. Dhoni collects and whips off the bails and appeals for a stumping but nothing in it.
DROPPED! Length ball on middle and off, Moor looks to play the slog sweep but gets a top edge and the ball flies high. The bowler dives to catch it at mid on but is not successful.
Oohh... comes down the track, is beaten in flight but still swings hard. The ball goes off the inside edge and just misses the stumps on its way to short fine leg.
Outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Looks to swing hard but gets it from the inner half of the bat through mid-wicket. A single taken.
On middle and off, clobbered over the non-striker towards long on who has been kept a bit straighter. A single taken.
Down the leg side, Peter misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
FOUR! Bang! Out of my way! That is a partner-killer. Landed outside off, Moor crashes this straight back and almost takes Chigumbura's head with him as the ball races to the fence!
Slows this up considerably, around off, 83.4 kph, coming in with the arm, pushed back to the bowler.

SIX! That is a monster! A tad short outside off, a little bit of away turn, Moor gets underneath it and sends it flying over long on! That has gone over the roof and outside the ground! New ball please!
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Chigumbura comes down the track, looking to push it to the off side, and is hit high on the thigh pads.
The batsman comes down the track and does well to get his body behind the ball. The fielding side are asking the question. The Umpire shows no interest in the appeal.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Length ball outside leg, Chigumbura misses it and is hit on the pads.
The Man Of The Match in the previous game, ELTON CHIGUMBURA, walks in at number 7, replacing Waller. He has his hands full today.
OUT! Excellent catch! Short outside off, Waller lofts it over covers but Patel over there dives to his right and takes it with both hands. The threatening partnership has been broken.
Floated outside off, pushed to the covers for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Length ball outside off, Waller misses the ball but nearly edges it to the keeper.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Terrific effort! Could have been taken though. A length ball on middle, 92.7 kph, Moor swings this over wide long on. Ambati Rayudu runs to his right, covers good ground, takes the catch but is unable to hold on as he knows he is losing balance. He throws the ball away, crosses the boundary and comes in. Two runs taken.
Short and outside off, punched to long off for a single.
AXAR PATEL gets a change of ends.
Short again, cut away through cover for one.
A touch short on off, spinning away, 82.8 kph, punched through the covers for a run.
Down the leg side, gently flicked past short fine leg for a couple.
Full on middle, 88.3 kph, pushed back to the bowler.
Landed outside off, reverse swept straight to short third man.
Tossed up on middle, pushed through the covers for a single.
Pitched on leg, Moor swings but misses as the ball spins into him. A sign of his growing frustration.
Length ball on middle, punches off the back foot back to the bowler.
Short outside off, Moor looks to push it but the ball spins away from him.
Full on off, driven superbly through the covers for a single.
Full outside off, pushed to the off side.
Short outside off, Waller attempts to hit but misses the slower ball.
Full on the stumps, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Moor pushes it to the covers for a single.
Full on middle and off, driven to mid on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! That is a terrific shot! Floated outside off, Waller gets underneath this and lofts it over covers for a boundary!
Short and outside off, pulled over mid-wicket for a couple.
YUZVENDRA CHAHAL into the attack as well.
Goes back to flick but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Goes back to flick but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Outside off, punches this down to long off for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Landed on middle, punched down to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
AXAR PATEL to bowl now.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
DROPPED! Short outside off, the batsman plays a square cut and the ball goes flying into the hands of Manish Panday who drops a sitter.
Short outside off, Waller cuts it to the cover fielder.
Short outside middle and off, Moor looks well-balanced and places the ball to mid on for a single.
Length ball outside on off, punched through mid on and the batsmen run a double.
FOUR! Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a boundary!
MALCOLM WALLER is the next man in.

OUT! LBW! That is a tough call for Mutombodzi. It was on a length, curving in, the batsman missed his flick and was hit on the pads. Sran appealed for LBW and the umpire raised his finger after a thought. Oh dear... replays showed that the ball was pitched outside leg. Hard luck for Mutombodzi but Sran will take it. He is on a hat-trick now! What an over - 3 runs and 3 wickets!
TINOTENDA MUTOMBODZI is the next batsman in.

OUT! That is a terrific catch! Fractionally short of a length outside off, Raza looks to run it down to third man but cannot keep it down. The ball dies on its way to the fielder at gully but Lokesh Rahul does extremely well to pick it inches above the ground. He charges in celebration and the Indians are pumped up. Second wicket in the over!
Barinder Sran is looking all pumped up. Perhaps he was not happy after being left out in the first T20I.
Outside off, dabbed through point where Axar dives to his left to stop the ball. A run taken.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
SIKANDAR RAZA walks in at number 4, replacing Masakadza.

OUT! Clean bowled by Sran! Full on middle and leg, Masakadza swings for it but gets confused by the length. The ball passes between bat and pad, smashes into the stumps and sends them flying. The hosts in some early trouble now.
Short outside off, Moor attempts to flick it but is struck on the thigh pad. The batsmen run a single as the ball moves to square leg. Leg byes signaled by the umpire

FOUR! Another shot with pure power. Kulkarni keeps this straight, Masakadza backs away and plays an ugly heave cum pull. It is not good to look but has plenty of gains as the ball races past mid on for a boundary. 10 from the over, Zimbabwe get things going.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short and outside off, 130.4 kph, cut straight to point.
Comes down the track and looks to slap but mistimes it wide of mid off and takes a quick run.
FOUR! That has been crashed. Full and wide outside off, Masakadza picks the bones out of that one as he crashes it through cover-point for a boundary.
On a length on middle, 132.4 kph, Masakadza goes back and punches it back to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, flicked to fine leg for a single.
PETER MOOR walks in at number 3, replacing Chibhabha.

OUT! Full on middle and off, Chibhabha slogs it over long on and the ball is airborne. However, he doesn't time it too well and miscues it. Rayudu covers good ground from mid on and runs hard to get to the ball. Early success for India.
Length ball on off, driven straight to the fielder at extra cover.
On middle and leg, Hamilton misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards point. A leg bye taken. He is still not off the mark.
WIDE. Strays down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Down the leg side, Chamu misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads to short fine leg. The batsmen take a leg bye.
On a length on off, Chibhabha looks to punch but hits it in an ugly manner back to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, Masakadza reaches out but the ball is much closer to the stumps and he pulls back to let it through.
WIDE. Short and wide outside off, Masakadza goes for it again but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
Short outside off, a big swing but Masakadza misses.
Short outside off, Masakadza tries to pull but the ball goes to mid off.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square. They pick up a single.
Better from Kulkarni, on a length outside off, 130.2 kph, Chamu stays leg side of the ball and slashes hard but misses.
FOUR! Starts off with a loose one, short and wide outside off, 130.7 kph, asking for punishment, Chibhabha gets underneath it and slaps it over point for a boundary.
DHAWAL KULKARNI to bowl from the other end.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Full outside leg, Masakadza misses his flick and is hit low on the pads.
Fuller on the leg side, worked away to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Short outside off, Chibhabha waits for it and cuts it into the ground over point and the ball races to the boundary.
Length ball outside off, Chibhabha looks to punch it off the back foot but mistimes his shot.
A length ball outside off, 125.4 kph, Chibhabha slashes hard but misses.

The players are out in the middle. Hamilton Masakadza and Chamu Chibhabha are the openers for Zimbabwe. Barinder Sran, who missed the last game, will start off the proceedings with the ball to Chibhabha.

Dhoni admits that India committed a lot of mistakes in the previous game and wants to improve the running between the wickets today. Also, wants to stop the leakage of boundaries in the middle overs. Feels that 150 is the score he is looking to chase.

Cremer says that it looks like a run-scoring wicket. Wants to put up a good total on board. Does not feel that the toss is too important as he reckons the pitch will not change much. Hopes that his team maintains his momentum from the previous game.
Toss - Graeme Cremer spins the coin, MS Dhoni calls tails but it is a head. ZIMBABWE ELECT TO BAT FIRST.
Pitch report - The skies look bright and sunny with no rain forecast.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 2nd T20I match between Zimbabwe and India. Powered by Neville Madziva in the death overs, the hosts stunned the Indian side with a surprise victory in the first match of the series, placing the pressure on the visitors. It will be a do-or-die match for India as they will need to win both remaining matches to win the series. Will MS Dhoni's wounded side be able to make a comeback or will Graeme Cremer's boys seal the deal and clinch a historic series win? Hopefully, we have a good match ahead of us.
